name: Gorgias
description: A customer support and helpdesk platform designed for e-commerce that centralizes tickets, messages, and customer data.

evidence.claim: Gorgias supports both API keys for private apps and OAuth2 for public apps.
API key authentication is implemented using HTTP Basic Auth with the username (email) and API key.
Gorgias has an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for connecting AI assistants.
The API is REST-based and covers resources like tickets, messages, customers, and events.
API access is available on all Helpdesk plans.

notes: Gorgias distinguishes between private apps (using API keys via Basic Auth) and public apps (requiring OAuth2). It also recently launched an official MCP server for AI integrations.
